title: All factions complete: Arcane Vanguard roster

groups.name: Arcane Order
items: All 15 Arcane units now have six-facing layered artwork, separate equipment and matching visual effects.
Frost, lightning, meteors, healing, Lance, Swap, Rewind, Silence, Flare, mana burn, reflection and wards follow actual gameplay.

groups.name: Complete roster
items: All 111 units are integrated: 107 new kits plus four original pilots, across seven factions and the raid boss.
Workshop audit rendered all 666 facing canvases without missing assets. Cache stayed at24 kits and reloaded evicted artwork.
Every faction test arena rendered its full roster and completed an end-turn cycle without browser errors.

groups.name: Animation fixes
items: Attacks and casts resume from their paused pose instead of jumping to idle.
Secondary chain/reflection projectiles travel correctly and respect hidden sources.
Workshop attack selection follows each unit, with direct faction test links.
